# Review sheet layout

One spreadsheet tab per intent type, so a person can review problems, ideals, solutions, implementations and metrics, with the latest verdict, without reading code. Structural columns are generated from the records and never edited in the sheet; the four `tracking_*` columns are the reviewers' own and are kept when the sheet is rebuilt. A blank `tracking_status` means "use `auto_status`".

## problems

| Column | Kind |
|---|---|
| `problem_id` | key |
| `problem` | generated |
| `who_has_it` | generated |
| `why_it_matters` | generated |
| `why_hard` | generated |
| `existing_attempts` | generated |
| `solution_ids` | generated |
| `ideal_ids` | generated |
| `component_ids` | generated |
| `auto_status` | generated |
| `tracking_status` | reviewer |
| `tracking_owner` | reviewer |
| `tracking_updated` | reviewer |
| `tracking_notes` | reviewer |
